# Open choices: test-design

`aidd-team:test-design` leaves these decisions to the team. aidd's default holds until a `standards` entry fills one. `aidd standard list` names the library standards for each choice, and `aidd standard add` adopts one.

| Choice | Question | aidd's default | Options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `integration-test-services` | How does an integration test start the databases and services it needs? | Testcontainers where the ecosystem has a library for it, one throwaway container per test run. | Testcontainers, Docker Compose started by the test run, the provider's local emulator |
